basis: Official documentation checked; project choices and thresholds are design decisions, not vendor guarantees

sources.finding: Consistent single-DB export; roles/other assets separate; version-aware tools and scope.
Archive execution is a trust boundary; data-only does not make hostile archive safe.
CONCURRENTLY cannot run inside a transaction block; failed builds can leave invalid indexes.
Persistent applies to OnCalendar; a missed activation does not replay every logical business occurrence.
Per-service mounted files; file bind mount does not supply encryption-at-rest or custody.
Health-based startup ordering does not prove application invariants or recovery readiness.
Daemon access is privileged; application, Ops UI and untrusted CI get no Docker socket.
Least privilege, untrusted event handling, reviewed actions pinned to full SHA.
Private hosted minutes/storage quotas and paid overage; do not promise all CI free.
Forget versus prune, OR retention counts, append-only malicious labels, repack scratch space.
